an4.187:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
an4.187:1.2: Atha kho Vassakāro brāhmaṇo Magadhamahāmatto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi . . .
an4.187:1.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Vassakāro brāhmaṇo Magadhamahāmatto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :
an4.187:2.1: Jāneyya nu kho bho Gotama asappuriso asappurisaṃ--
an4.187:2.3: Aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya--asappuriso
an4.187:2.5: Jāneyya pana bho Gotama asappuriso sappurisaṃ--
an4.187:2.7: Etam pi kho brāhmaṇa aṭṭhānaṃ anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya--sappuriso
an4.187:2.9: Jāneyya nu kho bho Gotama sappuriso sappurisaṃ--
an4.187:2.11: Thānaṃ kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa vijjati yaṃ sappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya--sappuriso
an4.187:2.13: Jāneyya pana bho Gotama sappuriso asappurisaṃ--
an4.187:2.15: Etam pi kho brāhmaṇa ṭhānaṃ vijjati yaṃ sappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya--asappuriso
an4.187:3.1: Acchariyaṃ bho Gotama abbhutaṃ bho Gotama
an4.187:3.2: yāva subhāsitaṃ c' idaṃ bhotā Gotamena:
an4.187:3.3: Aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya--asappuriso
an4.187:3.5: Etam pi kho brāhmaṇa aṭṭhānaṃ anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya--sappuriso
an4.187:3.7: Ṭhānaṃ kho [pan' ] etaṃ brāhmaṇa vijjati yaṃ sappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya--sappuriso
an4.187:3.9: Etam pi kho brāhmaṇa ṭhānaṃ vijjati yaṃ sappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya
an4.187:4.1: Ekam idaṃ bho Gotama samayaṃ Todeyyassa brāhmaṇassa parisatī parūpārambhaṃ vattenti:
an4.187:4.2: bālo ayaṃ rājā Eḷeyyo yo samaṇe Rāmaputte abhippasanno samaṇe ca pana Rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccākāraṃ karoti yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamman ti.
an4.187:4.3: Ime pi rañño Eḷeyyassa parihārakā bālā,
an4.187:4.4: Yamako Moggallo Uggo Nāvindaki Gandhabbo Aggivesso, ye samaṇe Rāmaputte abhippasannā samaṇe ca pana Rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccākāraṃ karonti yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamman ti.
an4.187:4.5: Tyassudaṃ Todeyyo brāhmaṇo iminā nayena neti.
an4.187:4.7: rājā Eḷeyyo karaṇīyādhikaraṇīyesu vacanīyādhivacanīyesu alamatthadasatarehi alamatthadasataro ti?
an4.187:4.8: Evaṃ bho paṇḍito rājā Eḷeyyo karaṇīyādhikaraṇīyesu vacanīyādhivacanīyesu alamatthadasatarehi alamatthadasataro ti.
an4.187:5.1: Yasmā kho bho samaṇo Rāmaputto rañño Eḷeyyena paṇḍitena paṇḍitaro karanīyādhikaranīyesu vacanīyādhivacanīyesu alamatthadasatarena alamatthadasataro tasmā rājā Eḷeyyo samaṇe Rāmaputte abhippasanno samaṇe ca pana Rāmaputte ca evarūpaṃ paramanipaccākāraṃ karoti yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ.
an4.187:6.3: Yamako Moggallo Uggo Nāvindaki Gandhabbo Aggivesso, karaṇīyādhikaraṇiyesu vacanīyādhivacanīyesu alamatthadasatarehi alamatthadasatarā ti?
an4.187:6.4: Evaṃ bho paṇḍitā rañño Eleyyassa parihārakā,
an4.187:6.5: Yamako Moggallo Uggo Nāvindaki Gandhabbo Aggivesso, karanīyādhikaraṇīyesu vacanīyādhivacanīyesu alamatthadasaterehi alamatthadasatarāti.
an4.187:7.1: Yasmā kho bho samaṇo Rāmaputto rañño Eḷeyyassa parihārakehi paṇḍitehi paṇḍitaro karaṇīyādhikaraṇīyesu vacanīyādhikaraṇīyesu alamatthadasatarehi alamatthadasataro tasmā rañño Eḷeyyassa parihārakā samaṇe Rāmaputte abhippasannā
an4.187:7.2: samaṇe ca pana Rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccākāraṃ karonti yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamman ti. 7.
an4.187:8.2: yāva subhāsitaṃ c' idaṃ bhota Gotamena:
an4.187:8.3: Aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya--asappuriso
an4.187:8.5: Etam pi kho brāhmaṇa aṭṭhānaṃ anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya--sappuriso
an4.187:8.7: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ brāhmaṇa vijjati yaṃ sappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya--sappuriso
an4.187:8.9: Etam pi kho brāhmaṇo ṭhānaṃ vijjati yaṃ sappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya--asappuriso
an4.187:8.11: Handa ca dāni mayaṃ bho Gotama gacchāma
an4.187:8.13: Yassa dāni tvaṃ brāhmaṇa kālaṃ maññasīti.
an4.187:9.1: Atha kho Vassakāro brāhmaṇo Magadhamahāmatto Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā utthāyāsanā pakkāmīti. 188. 1.
